mapper.select: SELECT ccr.id, ccr.process_instance_id, ccr.process_definition_id, ccr.node_id, ccr.node_name, ccr.cc_targets, ccr.cc_user_ids, ccr.cc_user_names, ccr.notify_type, ccr.require_read, ccr.cc_time FROM wf_cc_record ccr INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ccr.process_instance_id = pi.id WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(ccr.cc_user_ids, CONCAT('"', #{userId}, '"')) AND pi.app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY ccr.cc_time DESC

SELECT ccr.id, ccr.process_instance_id, ccr.process_definition_id, ccr.node_id, ccr.node_name, ccr.cc_targets, ccr.cc_user_ids, ccr.cc_user_names, ccr.notify_type, ccr.require_read, ccr.cc_time FROM wf_cc_record ccr INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ccr.process_instance_id = pi.id WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(ccr.cc_user_ids, CONCAT('"', #{userId}, '"')) AND pi.app_id IS NULL ORDER BY ccr.cc_time DESC
